import json
from typing import List, Dict, Any, Optional, Tuple

# Helper functions assumed to exist in the environment
# node_by_title(doc, title) -> node dict
# node_by_id(doc, node_id) -> node dict
# children(doc, node) -> list of node dicts
# scope_nodes(doc, scope) -> list of node dicts that are direct children of scope
# table_rows(node) -> list of (row_index, {column: cell_string, ...})

def _add_entity(res: List[Dict[str, str]], seen: set, id_: str, desc: str) -> None:
    if id_ not in seen:
        seen.add(id_)
        res.append({"id": id_, "description": desc})


def entities(doc: Dict[str, Any], scope: str) -> List[Dict[str, str]]:
    """Return all distinct entity descriptions within the specified scope."""
    res: List[Dict[str, str]] = []
    seen: set = set()

    # Cluster itself
    _add_entity(res, seen, scope, f"Cluster for {scope}")

    # Gather machines, tasks and jobs from tables under this scope
    for node in scope_nodes(doc, scope):
        if node["kind"] != "table":
            continue

        title = node["title"]
        rows = table_rows(node)

        if title.endswith(": Machines"):
            for row_idx, row in rows:
                machine_id = row["machine"]
                _add_entity(res, seen, machine_id,
                            f"Machine {machine_id} (CPU={row['CPU']}, Mem={row['memory']})")

        if title.endswith(": Task log"):
            for row_idx, row in rows:
                task_id = row["task"]
                job_id = row["job"]
                priority = row["priority"]
                _add_entity(res, seen, task_id,
                            f"Task {task_id} (Job={job_id}, Prio={priority})")
                _add_entity(res, seen, job_id, f"Job {job_id}")

    return res


def recorded_end(doc: Dict[str, Any], scope: str) -> Optional[float]:
    """Return the last time point covered by the scope's records."""
    max_time: Optional[float] = None

    def upd(t: float):
        nonlocal max_time
        if max_time is None or t > max_time:
            max_time = t

    for node in scope_nodes(doc, scope):
        if node["kind"] == "table" and node["title"].endswith(": Task log"):
            for _, row in table_rows(node):
                try:
                    upd(float(row["time"]))
                except (KeyError, ValueError):
                    pass

        if node["kind"] == "list" and node["title"].endswith(": Events"):
            for line in node["lines"]:
                parts = line.split(":")
                if parts and parts[0].lower().startswith("time"):
                    try:
                        upd(float(parts[0].split()[1]))
                    except ValueError:
                        pass

    return max_time


def inputs(doc: Dict[str, Any], scope: str) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """Extract all inputs that come from outside the scheduling process."""
    res: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []

    for node in scope_nodes(doc, scope):
        if node["kind"] == "table":
            title = node["title"]

            if title.endswith(": Machines"):
                for row_idx, row in table_rows(node):
                    machine_id = row["machine"]
                    fails_at = None if row["fails at"] in ("-", "never") else float(row["fails at"])
                    returns_at = None if row["returns at"] in ("-", "never") else float(row["returns at"])
                    res.append({
                        "id": f"mi_{machine_id}",
                        "time": None,
                        "kind": "machine_init",
                        "entities": [machine_id],
                        "fields": {
                            "CPU": int(row["CPU"]),
                            "memory": int(row["memory"]),
                            "fails_at": fails_at,
                            "returns_at": returns_at,
                        },
                        "src": [[node["node_id"], row_idx]],
                    })

            elif title.endswith(": Task log"):
                for row_idx, row in table_rows(node):
                    if row["event"] == "submit":
                        task_id = row["task"]
                        job_id = row["job"]
                        res.append({
                            "id": f"submit_{task_id}",
                            "time": float(row["time"]),
                            "kind": "submission",
                            "entities": [task_id, job_id],
                            "fields": {
                                "priority": int(row["priority"]),
                                "CPU": int(row["CPU"]),
                                "memory": int(row["memory"]),
                                "run_time": int(row["run time"]),
                            },
                            "src": [[node["node_id"], row_idx]],
                        })

    return res


def outcomes(doc: Dict[str, Any], scope: str) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """Extract all outcomes that are produced by the scheduling process."""
    res: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []

    for node in scope_nodes(doc, scope):
        if node["kind"] == "table" and node["title"].endswith(": Task log"):
            for row_idx, row in table_rows(node):
                evt = row["event"]
                if evt == "submit":
                    # submissions are inputs, not outcomes
                    continue

                time_val = float(row["time"])
                ent: List[str] = [row["task"]]
                if row["machine"] != "-":
                    ent.append(row["machine"])

                outcome: Dict[str, Any] = {
                    "time": time_val,
                    "kind": evt,
                    "entities": ent,
                    "value": None,
                    "src": [[node["node_id"], row_idx]],
                }
                if evt == "finish":
                    # finish event signifies task completion, remaining time is 0
                    outcome["value"] = 0
                res.append(outcome)

    return res


def params(doc: Dict[str, Any], scope: str) -> Dict[str, float]:
    """Return any constant numerical values explicitly stated within the scope."""
    # The document does not declare any explicit numeric constants in this scope.
    return {}

# Forward model of the scheduler

import heapq
from collections import defaultdict, deque
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple, Any

# -------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper data structures
# -------------------------------------------------------------
class Machine:
    def __init__(self, mid: str, cpu: int, mem: int,
                 fails_at: Optional[float], returns_at: Optional[float]):
        self.id = mid
        self.cpu_total = cpu
        self.mem_total = mem
        self.cpu_free = cpu
        self.mem_free = mem
        self.up = True
        self.fails_at = fails_at
        self.returns_at = returns_at
        self.running: Dict[str, Task] = {}

class Task:
    def __init__(self, tid: str, job: str, prio: int,
                 cpu: int, mem: int, run_time: int,
                 submit: float):
        self.id = tid
        self.job = job
        self.prio = prio
        self.cpu_req = cpu
        self.mem_req = mem
        self.run_time = run_time
        self.remaining = run_time
        self.submit = submit
        self.start: Optional[float] = None
        self.machine: Optional[str] = None
        self.state = "waiting"   # waiting, running, finished

# -------------------------------------------------------------
# Basic helpers
# -------------------------------------------------------------
def idnum(mid: str) -> int:
    return int(mid[1:]) if mid.startswith("M") else int(mid)

def schedule_start(task: Task, machine: Machine, cur: float,
                   outcomes: List[Dict], finish_heap: List[Tuple[float, str]],
                   machine_finish: Dict[str, List[Tuple[float, Task]]]) -> None:
    task.start = cur
    task.machine = machine.id
    task.state = "running"
    machine.cpu_free -= task.cpu_req
    machine.mem_free -= task.mem_req
    machine.running[task.id] = task
    outcomes.append({
        "time": cur, "kind": "start",
        "entities": [task.id, machine.id],
        "value": None,
        "src": []
    })
    fin_t = cur + task.remaining
    heapq.heappush(finish_heap, (fin_t, task.id))
    machine_finish[task.machine].append((fin_t, task))
    machine_finish[task.machine].sort(key=lambda x: x[0])

# -------------------------------------------------------------
# Main simulate function
# -------------------------------------------------------------
def simulate(doc, scope, inputs, params,
             start: Optional[float] = None,
             horizon: Optional[float] = None) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    # 1. Build the initial state from the inputs
    machines: Dict[str, Machine] = {}
    tasks: Dict[str, Task] = {}
    submit_events: List[Tuple[float, Task]] = []

    for inp in inputs:
        if inp["kind"] == "machine_init":
            m = Machine(inp["entities"][0],
                        inp["fields"]["CPU"],
                        inp["fields"]["memory"],
                        inp["fields"]["fails_at"],
                        inp["fields"]["returns_at"])
            machines[m.id] = m
        elif inp["kind"] == "submission":
            t = Task(inp["entities"][0], inp["entities"][1],
                     inp["fields"]["priority"],
                     inp["fields"]["CPU"],
                     inp["fields"]["memory"],
                     inp["fields"]["run_time"],
                     inp["time"])
            tasks[t.id] = t
            submit_events.append((t.submit, t))

    submit_events.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])

    # 2. Determine simulation bounds
    recorded_end_val = recorded_end(doc, scope)
    if horizon is None:
        horizon = recorded_end_val if recorded_end_val is not None else float("inf")
    if start is None:
        start = 0.0

    # 3. Event queues and bookkeeping
    finish_heap: List[Tuple[float, str]] = []                 # (finish_time, task_id)
    submit_q = deque(submit_events)                          # sorted by submit time
    wait_queue: List[Task] = []                               # waiting tasks
    machine_finish: Dict[str, List[Tuple[float, Task]]] = defaultdict(list)

    fail_at: Dict[float, List[str]] = defaultdict(list)
    ret_at: Dict[float, List[str]] = defaultdict(list)
    for m in machines.values():
        if m.fails_at is not None:
            fail_at[m.fails_at].append(m.id)
        if m.returns_at is not None:
            ret_at[m.returns_at].append(m.id)

    outcomes: List[Dict] = []

    # 4. Helper sub‑routines
    def process_submissions(cur: float):
        while submit_q and submit_q[0][0] <= cur:
            _, t = submit_q.popleft()
            wait_queue.append(t)

    def sort_wait():
        wait_queue.sort(key=lambda t: (-t.prio, t.submit, t.id))

    def earliest_start(task: Task, mach: Machine, cur: float,
                       finlist: List[Tuple[float, Task]]) -> float:
        cf = mach.cpu_free
        mf = mach.mem_free
        t = cur
        for ft, tk in sorted(finlist, key=lambda x: x[0]):
            if cf >= task.cpu_req and mf >= task.mem_req:
                return t
            cf += tk.cpu_req
            mf += tk.mem_req
            t = ft
        if cf >= task.cpu_req and mf >= task.mem_req:
            return t
        return float("inf")

    def compute_reservation(task: Task, cur: float):
        best_t = float("inf")
        best_mid = None
        for m in sorted(machines.values(), key=lambda m: idnum(m.id)):
            if not m.up:
                continue
            finlist = machine_finish[m.id]
            t = earliest_start(task, m, cur, finlist)
            if t < best_t:
                best_t = t
                best_mid = m.id
        if best_mid is None:
            return None
        return best_mid, best_t

    # 5. Main simulation loop
    cur = 0.0
    while cur <= horizon:
        # Next event time
        times = []
        if finish_heap:
            times.append(finish_heap[0][0])
        if submit_q:
            times.append(submit_q[0][0])
        if fail_at:
            times.append(min(fail_at.keys()))
        if ret_at:
            times.append(min(ret_at.keys()))
        if not times:
            break
        nxt = min(t for t in times if t >= start)
        if nxt > horizon:
            break
        cur = nxt

        # ---- 1. Finish events ----
        while finish_heap and finish_heap[0][0] <= cur:
            ft, tid = heapq.heappop(finish_heap)
            tsk = tasks[tid]
            # Skip if task isn't currently running (evicted/failed)
            if tsk.machine is None or tsk.machine not in machines:
                continue
            m = machines[tsk.machine]
            if tsk.id not in m.running:
                continue
            m.cpu_free += tsk.cpu_req
            m.mem_free += tsk.mem_req
            m.running.pop(tsk.id)
            machine_finish[tsk.machine] = [(f, tk) for f, tk in machine_finish[tsk.machine] if tk.id != tsk.id]
            tsk.state = "finished"
            tsk.remaining = 0
            outcomes.append({
                "time": ft, "kind": "finish",
                "entities": [tsk.id, tsk.machine],
                "value": 0,
                "src": []
            })

        # ---- 2. Failures ----
        if cur in fail_at:
            for mid in fail_at[cur]:
                m = machines[mid]
                if not m.up:
                    continue
                m.up = False
                for t in list(m.running.values()):
                    outcomes.append({
                        "time": cur, "kind": "fail",
                        "entities": [t.id, mid],
                        "value": None,
                        "src": []
                    })
                    t.state = "waiting"
                    t.remaining = t.run_time
                    t.start = None
                    t.machine = None
                    wait_queue.append(t)
                m.running.clear()
                m.cpu_free = m.cpu_total
                m.mem_free = m.mem_total
                machine_finish[mid] = []          # cancel pending finish events
            fail_at.pop(cur, None)

        # ---- 3. Returns ----
        if cur in ret_at:
            for mid in ret_at[cur]:
                m = machines[mid]
                m.up = True
                m.cpu_free = m.cpu_total
                m.mem_free = m.mem_total
            ret_at.pop(cur, None)

        # ---- 4. Submissions ----
        process_submissions(cur)

        # ---- 5. Scheduling round ----
        sort_wait()
        reservation: Optional[Tuple[str, float]] = None   # (machine_id, start_time)
        i = 0
        while i < len(wait_queue):
            tsk = wait_queue[i]

            # a) First fit
            started = False
            for m in sorted(machines.values(), key=lambda m: idnum(m.id)):
                if not m.up:
                    continue
                if m.cpu_free >= tsk.cpu_req and m.mem_free >= tsk.mem_req:
                    schedule_start(tsk, m, cur, outcomes, finish_heap, machine_finish)
                    wait_queue.pop(i)
                    started = True
                    break
            if started:
                continue

            # b) Preemption (only during the same round, only for prod tasks)
            if reservation is None and tsk.prio >= 9:
                evicted = False
                for m in sorted(machines.values(), key=lambda m: idnum(m.id)):
                    if not m.up:
                        continue
                    ftasks = [r for r in m.running.values() if r.prio <= 1]
                    ftasks.sort(key=lambda r: (r.prio,
                                               -r.start if r.start is not None else -1,
                                               -int(r.id[1:])))
                    cf = m.cpu_free
                    mf = m.mem_free
                    for ev in ftasks:
                        cf += ev.cpu_req
                        mf += ev.mem_req
                        if cf >= tsk.cpu_req and mf >= tsk.mem_req:
                            to_ev = ftasks[:ftasks.index(ev)+1]
                            for ev_task in to_ev:
                                outcomes.append({
                                    "time": cur, "kind": "evict",
                                    "entities": [ev_task.id, m.id],
                                    "value": None,
                                    "src": []
                                })
                                ev_task.state = "waiting"
                                ev_task.remaining = ev_task.run_time
                                ev_task.start = None
                                ev_task.machine = None
                                wait_queue.append(ev_task)
                                m.running.pop(ev_task.id)
                                m.cpu_free += ev_task.cpu_req
                                m.mem_free += ev_task.mem_req
                                machine_finish[m.id] = [(f, tk) for f, tk in machine_finish[m.id] if tk.id != ev_task.id]
                            schedule_start(tsk, m, cur, outcomes, finish_heap, machine_finish)
                            wait_queue.pop(i)
                            evicted = True
                            break
                    if evicted:
                        break
                if evicted:
                    continue

            # c) Reservation
            if reservation is None:
                cand = compute_reservation(tsk, cur)
                if cand is not None:
                    reservation = cand
                i += 1
                continue

            # d) Backfilling / reservation handling
            res_mid, res_time = reservation
            if cur + tsk.remaining <= res_time:
                m = machines[res_mid]
                if m.up and m.cpu_free >= tsk.cpu_req and m.mem_free >= tsk.mem_req:
                    schedule_start(tsk, m, cur, outcomes, finish_heap, machine_finish)
                    wait_queue.pop(i)
                    continue
            placed = False
            for m in sorted(machines.values(), key=lambda m: idnum(m.id)):
                if m.id == res_mid:
                    continue
                if not m.up:
                    continue
                if m.cpu_free >= tsk.cpu_req and m.mem_free >= tsk.mem_req:
                    schedule_start(tsk, m, cur, outcomes, finish_heap, machine_finish)
                    wait_queue.pop(i)
                    placed = True
                    break
            if placed:
                continue

            i += 1

    # 6. Return outcomes ordered by time
    outcomes.sort(key=lambda d: (d["time"], d["entities"]))
    return outcomes

# - table_rows(node) -> list of (row_index, {column: cell_string, ...})

def entities(doc: Dict[str, Any], scope: str) -> List[Dict[str, str]]:
    """
    Return all distinct entity descriptions within the specified scope.

    Entities are identified by the following rules:

    * Every machine id appearing in the "Machines" table.
    * Every task id appearing as an event other than 'submit' in the
      "Task log" table.
    * Every job id appearing as a task reference.
    * The cluster itself, identified by the scope title.

    The result includes a human‑readable description for each entity.
    """
    res: List[Dict[str, str]] = []

    # the cluster
    res.append({"id": scope, "description": f"Cluster for {scope}"})

    # helper to add an entity only once
    seen = set()
    def add_entity(id_: str, desc: str):
        if id_ not in seen:
            seen.add(id_)
            res.append({"id": id_, "description": desc})

    # collect from Machines table
    for node in scope_nodes(doc, scope):
        if node["kind"] == "table" and node["title"].endswith(": Machines"):
            for row_idx, row in table_rows(node):
                machine_id = row["machine"]
                add_entity(machine_id,
                           f"Machine {machine_id} (CPU={row['CPU']}, Mem={row['memory']})")

        # collect from Task log table
        if node["kind"] == "table" and node["title"].endswith(": Task log"):
            for row_idx, row in table_rows(node):
                if row["event"] == "start" or row["event"] == "finish" \
                   or row["event"] == "evict" or row["event"] == "fail":
                    task_id = row["task"]
                    add_entity(task_id,
                               f"Task {task_id} (Job={row['job']}, Prio={row['priority']})")
                    job_id = row["job"]
                    add_entity(job_id, f"Job {job_id}")

    return res


def recorded_end(doc: Dict[str, Any], scope: str) -> Optional[float]:
    """
    Return the last time (in seconds) that is referenced in any table or
    list within the scope.

    It is computed as the maximum of all numeric time columns in the
    "Machines", "Task log" tables and any "Time ...:" prefixes in
    the Events lists.

    If no time appears, return None.
    """
    max_time: Optional[float] = None

    def upd(t: float):
        nonlocal max_time
        if max_time is None or t > max_time:
            max_time = t

    # Machines: no explicit time
    # Task log
    for node in scope_nodes(doc, scope):
        if node["kind"] == "table" and node["title"].endswith(": Task log"):
            for _, row in table_rows(node):
                try:
                    t = float(row["time"])
                    upd(t)
                except (KeyError, ValueError):
                    pass
        # Events list
        if node["kind"] == "list" and node["title"].endswith(": Events"):
            for line in node["lines"]:
                # e.g. "Time 424: ..."
                pref = line.split(":")[0]
                if pref.lower().startswith("time"):
                    try:
                        t = float(pref.split()[1])
                        upd(t)
                    except ValueError:
                        pass

    return max_time


def inputs(doc: Dict[str, Any], scope: str) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    Extract all inputs that come *from outside* the scheduling process
    and are recorded in the document.

    For the given scope we consider:

    * Machine initial state (the entire row of a machine).
    * Each machine failure time (if any) and return time (if any).
    * Every task submission event (the row with event 'submit').
    """
    res: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    id_counter = 0

    for node in scope_nodes(doc, scope):

        # Machines table
        if node["kind"] == "table" and node["title"].endswith(": Machines"):
            for row_idx, row in table_rows(node):
                machine_id = row["machine"]
                inp = {
                    "id": f"mi{machine_id}",
                    "time": None,
                    "kind": "machine_init",
                    "entities": [machine_id],
                    "fields": {
                        "CPU": int(row["CPU"]),
                        "memory": int(row["memory"]),
                        "fails_at": None if row["fails at"] == "-" else float(row["fails at"]),
                        "returns_at": None if row["returns at"] == "-" or row["returns at"] == "never" else float(row["returns at"]),
                    },
                    "src": [[node["node_id"], row_idx]],
                }
                res.append(inp)

        # Task log table
        if node["kind"] == "table" and node["title"].endswith(": Task log"):
            for row_idx, row in table_rows(node):
                if row["event"] == "submit":
                    inp = {
                        "id": f"submit_{row['task']}",
                        "time": float(row["time"]),
                        "kind": "submission",
                        "entities": [row["task"], row["job"]],
                        "fields": {
                            "priority": int(row["priority"]),
                            "CPU": int(row["CPU"]),
                            "memory": int(row["memory"]),
                            "run_time": int(row["run time"]),
                        },
                        "src": [[node["node_id"], row_idx]],
                    }

    return res


def outcomes(doc: Dict[str, Any], scope: str) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    Extract all events that are *generated* by the scheduling process.

    It is mainly the rows in the Task log that are not 'submit'.
    For completeness, we also record 'evict' and 'fail' as separate events.

    Each outcome has:
        * time: the event time
        * kind: the event name
        * entities: list of involved entity ids
        * value: None (or remaining time for finish events)
        * src: location of the row
    """
    res: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []

import heapq

from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple, Any

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper data structures
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
class Machine:
    def __init__(self, mid: str, cpu: int, mem: int,
                 fails_at: Optional[float], returns_at: Optional[float]):
        self.id = mid
        self.cpu_total = cpu
        self.mem_total = mem
        self.cpu_free = cpu
        self.mem_free = mem
        self.up = True
        self.fails_at = fails_at
        self.returns_at = returns_at
        self.running: Dict[str, Task] = {}

class Task:
    def __init__(self, tid: str, job: str, prio: int,
                 cpu: int, mem: int, run_time: int,
                 submit: float):
        self.id = tid
        self.job = job
        self.prio = prio
        self.cpu_req = cpu
        self.mem_req = mem
        self.run_time = run_time
        self.remaining = run_time
        self.submit = submit
        self.start: Optional[float] = None
        self.machine: Optional[str] = None
        self.state = "waiting"   # waiting, running, finished

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Basic helpers
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
def idnum(mid: str) -> int:
    """Return numeric part of a machine id such as 'M07' → 7."""
    return int(mid[1:]) if mid.startswith("M") else int(mid)

def schedule_start(task: Task, machine: Machine, cur: float,
                   outcomes: List[Dict], finish_heap: List[Tuple[float, str]],
                   machine_finish: Dict[str, List[Tuple[float, Task]]]) -> None:
    """Start a task on a machine and record the event."""
    task.start = cur
    task.machine = machine.id
    task.state = "running"
    machine.cpu_free -= task.cpu_req
    machine.mem_free -= task.mem_req
    machine.running[task.id] = task
    outcomes.append({
        "time": cur, "kind": "start",
        "entities": [task.id, machine.id],
        "value": None,
        "src": []
    })
    fin_t = cur + task.remaining
    heapq.heappush(finish_heap, (fin_t, task.id))
    machine_finish[task.machine].append((fin_t, task))
    machine_finish[task.machine].sort()

    Forward model of the scheduling process described in the document.

        inputs   – list of input events (machine_init, submission)

                     inp["fields"]["memory"],

                       finlist: List[Tuple[float, Task]]) -> float:

            cf += tk.cpu_req
            mf += tk.mem_req
            t = ft
        if cf >= task.cpu_req and mf >= task.mem_req:

        return float("inf")

            finlist = machine_finish[m.id]
            t = earliest_start(task, m, cur, finlist)
            if t < best_t:

                best_mid = m.id

        if fail_at:

            times.append(min(ret_at.keys()))

        if nxt > horizon:

            m = machines[tsk.machine]

            m.mem_free += tsk.mem_req
            m.running.pop(tsk.id)
            machine_finish[tsk.machine] = [(f, tk) for f, tk in machine_finish[tsk.machine] if tk.id != tsk.id]

                "entities": [tsk.id, tsk.machine],

                "src": []

                        "entities": [t.id, mid],
                        "value": None,
                        "src": []
                    })

                    t.remaining = t.run_time
                    t.start = None
                    t.machine = None
                    wait_queue.append(t)
                m.running.clear()
                m.cpu_free = m.cpu_total
                m.mem_free = m.mem_total
            fail_at.pop(cur, None)   # Remove processed time

        # ---- 3. Returns ----
        if cur in ret_at:
            for mid in ret_at[cur]:
                m = machines[mid]
                m.up = True
                m.cpu_free = m.cpu_total
                m.mem_free = m.mem_total
            ret_at.pop(cur, None)   # Remove processed time

        # ---- 4. Submissions ----
        process_submissions(cur)

        # ---- 5. Scheduling round ----
        sort_wait()
        reservation: Optional[Tuple[str, float]] = None   # (machine_id, start_time)
        i = 0
        while i < len(wait_queue):
            tsk = wait_queue[i]

            # a) First fit
            started = False
            for m in sorted(machines.values(), key=lambda m: idnum(m.id)):
                if not m.up:
                    continue
                if m.cpu_free >= tsk.cpu_req and m.mem_free >= tsk.mem_req:
                    schedule_start(tsk, m, cur, outcomes, finish_heap, machine_finish)
                    wait_queue.pop(i)
                    started = True
                    break
            if started:
                continue

                evicted = False
                for m in sorted(machines.values(), key=lambda m: idnum(m.id)):
                    if not m.up:
                        continue
                    ftasks = [r for r in m.running.values() if r.prio <= 1]
                    ftasks.sort(key=lambda r: (r.prio,
                                               -r.start if r.start is not None else -1,
                                               -int(r.id[1:])))
                    cf = m.cpu_free
                    mf = m.mem_free
                    for ev in ftasks:
                        cf += ev.cpu_req
                        mf += ev.mem_req
                        if cf >= tsk.cpu_req and mf >= tsk.mem_req:
                            to_ev = ftasks[:ftasks.index(ev)+1]
                            for ev_task in to_ev:
                                outcomes.append({
                                    "time": cur, "kind": "evict",
                                    "entities": [ev_task.id, m.id],
                                    "value": None,
                                    "src": []
                                })
                                ev_task.state = "waiting"
                                ev_task.remaining = ev_task.run_time
                                ev_task.start = None
                                ev_task.machine = None
                                wait_queue.append(ev_task)
                                m.running.pop(ev_task.id)
                                m.cpu_free += ev_task.cpu_req
                                m.mem_free += ev_task.mem_req
                                machine_finish[m.id] = [(f, tk) for f, tk in machine_finish[m.id] if tk.id != ev_task.id]
                            schedule_start(tsk, m, cur, outcomes, finish_heap, machine_finish)
                            wait_queue.pop(i)
                            evicted = True
                            break
                    if evicted:
                        break
                if evicted:
                    continue

            # c) Reservation
            if reservation is None:
                cand = compute_reservation(tsk, cur)
                if cand is not None:
                    reservation = cand
                i += 1
                continue

            # d) Backfilling / reservation handling
            res_mid, res_time = reservation
            if cur + tsk.remaining <= res_time:
                m = machines[res_mid]
                if m.up and m.cpu_free >= tsk.cpu_req and m.mem_free >= tsk.mem_req:
                    schedule_start(tsk, m, cur, outcomes, finish_heap, machine_finish)
                    wait_queue.pop(i)
                    continue
            placed = False
            for m in sorted(machines.values(), key=lambda m: idnum(m.id)):
                if m.id == res_mid:
                    continue
                if not m.up:
                    continue
                if m.cpu_free >= tsk.cpu_req and m.mem_free >= tsk.mem_req:
                    schedule_start(tsk, m, cur, outcomes, finish_heap, machine_finish)
                    wait_queue.pop(i)
                    placed = True
                    break
            if placed:
                continue

            i += 1

    # 6. Return outcomes ordered by time
    outcomes.sort(key=lambda d: (d["time"], d["entities"]))
    return outcomes

                        "src": []
                    })
                    t.state = "waiting"
                    t.remaining = t.run_time
                    t.start = None
                    t.machine = None
                    wait_queue.append(t)
                m.running.clear()
                m.cpu_free = m.cpu_total
                m.mem_free = m.mem_total
                machine_finish[mid] = []          # cancel pending finish events
            fail_at.pop(cur, None)

        # ---- 3. Returns ----
        if cur in ret_at:
            for mid in ret_at[cur]:
                m = machines[mid]
                m.up = True
                m.cpu_free = m.cpu_total
                m.mem_free = m.mem_total
            ret_at.pop(cur, None)

        # ---- 4. Submissions ----
        process_submissions(cur)

        # ---- 5. Scheduling round ----
        sort_wait()
        reservation: Optional[Tuple[str, float]] = None   # (machine_id, start_time)
        i = 0
        while i < len(wait_queue):
            tsk = wait_queue[i]

            # a) First fit
            started = False
            for m in sorted(machines.values(), key=lambda m: idnum(m.id)):
                if not m.up:
                    continue
                if m.cpu_free >= tsk.cpu_req and m.mem_free >= tsk.mem_req:
                    schedule_start(tsk, m, cur, outcomes, finish_heap, machine_finish)
                    wait_queue.pop(i)
                    started = True
                    break
            if started:
                continue

            # b) Preemption (only during the same round, only for prod tasks)
            if reservation is None and tsk.prio >= 9:
                evicted = False
                for m in sorted(machines.values(), key=lambda m: idnum(m.id)):
                    if not m.up:
                        continue
                    ftasks = [r for r in m.running.values() if r.prio <= 1]
                    ftasks.sort(key=lambda r: (r.prio,
                                               -r.start if r.start is not None else -1,
                                               -int(r.id[1:])))
                    cf = m.cpu_free
                    mf = m.mem_free
                    for ev in ftasks:
                        cf += ev.cpu_req
                        mf += ev.mem_req
                        if cf >= tsk.cpu_req and mf >= tsk.mem_req:
                            to_ev = ftasks[:ftasks.index(ev)+1]
                            for ev_task in to_ev:
                                outcomes.append({
                                    "time": cur, "kind": "evict",
                                    "entities": [ev_task.id, m.id],
                                    "value": None,
                                    "src": []
                                })
                                ev_task.state = "waiting"
                                ev_task.remaining = ev_task.run_time
                                ev_task.start = None
                                ev_task.machine = None
                                wait_queue.append(ev_task)
                                m.running.pop(ev_task.id)
                                m.cpu_free += ev_task.cpu_req
                                m.mem_free += ev_task.mem_req
                                machine_finish[m.id] = [(f, tk) for f, tk in machine_finish[m.id] if tk.id != ev_task.id]
                            schedule_start(tsk, m, cur, outcomes, finish_heap, machine_finish)
                            wait_queue.pop(i)
                            evicted = True
                            break
                    if evicted:
                        break
                if evicted:
                    continue

            # c) Reservation
            if reservation is None:
                cand = compute_reservation(tsk, cur)
                if cand is not None:
                    reservation = cand
                i += 1
                continue

            # d) Backfilling / reservation handling
            res_mid, res_time = reservation
            if cur + tsk.remaining <= res_time:
                m = machines[res_mid]
                if m.up and m.cpu_free >= tsk.cpu_req and m.mem_free >= tsk.mem_req:
                    schedule_start(tsk, m, cur, outcomes, finish_heap, machine_finish)
                    wait_queue.pop(i)
                    continue
            placed = False
            for m in sorted(machines.values(), key=lambda m: idnum(m.id)):
                if m.id == res_mid:
                    continue
                if not m.up:
                    continue
                if m.cpu_free >= tsk.cpu_req and m.mem_free >= tsk.mem_req:
                    schedule_start(tsk, m, cur, outcomes, finish_heap, machine_finish)
                    wait_queue.pop(i)
                    placed = True
                    break
            if placed:
                continue

            i += 1

    # 6. Return outcomes ordered by time
    outcomes.sort(key=lambda d: (d["time"], d["entities"]))
    return outcomes
